# Altius Badminton Club

> Professional badminton club in Chișinău, Moldova. Training for children and adults, individual and group sessions, competition preparation. Operating since 2010.

## Key facts
- Location: Chișinău, Moldova
- Phone: +37369509892
- Email: info@altius.md
- Languages: Romanian, Russian, English
- Founded: 2010
- Students: 500+
- Coaches: certified badminton trainers
- Training formats: group (up to 8), individual, competition prep

## Locations (3 gyms)
1. Club Sportiv "Altius" — Strada Ion Creangă 1/2, Chișinău — +37369509892
2. Complexul Sportiv USMF "Nicolae Testemițanu" (Centru) — 31 August 1989 St 141, Chișinău — +37369111553
3. USMF University Sports Complex (Mălina Mică) — Strada Nicolae Testemițanu 24/5, Chișinău — +37369111553

## Services
- Group training (beginners and amateurs, up to 8 people)
- Individual training (1-on-1 with coach)
- Competition preparation (tournament-level)
- Children's groups and adult groups
- Pricing from 200 MDL/month
